scope: controlled R14 TABLE wire and fail-closed reader; not native semantics
references: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 sections 2.13 and 20.4.96.1
observations: The hash-bound R14 TABLE payload is preserved bit for bit except its attribute flag and the inserted first ATTRIB, last ATTRIB and SEQEND references.
LibreDWG reopens the derivative with TABLE 528, ATTRIB 705 and SEQEND 706 owned by TABLE 528; the TABLE frame CRC is valid.
The bounded parser resolves endpoints, preserves the following style handle and rejects malformed roles, overflows and truncation before corrected retry.
The file reader withholds the incomplete compound, delivers an unrelated TABLE and can retry the original input on the same adapter, with the grid callback enabled, disabled or absent.
Generated R13, R14 and R2000 controls cover null endpoints, relative forms and reset/retry. AddressSanitizer focused checks pass.
limits: The source and derivative remain outside the repository.
Other unsupported source objects are not qualified by LibreDWG's rewrite.
This is not native TABLE attribute, cloning, display, or output evidence.
This evidence does not establish native producer behavior, TABLE cell semantics, complete aggregate publication, lossless output or wider support.
